# server.qa

> Answers a question about a paper with grounded citations.

<!-- Generated by scripts/modules/generate-agents.mjs from module.manifest.json
     and module.narrative.md. Edit those, not this file. -->

The JSON schema forces citations and concepts, but a schema cannot make a
citation _true_. The real invariant is downstream: a citation must carry `page >= 1` and a
non-empty quote, and no bullet may reference a citation id that is not in the map. Answers
that cannot meet that are degraded honestly rather than decorated with a plausible source.

## Interface

Entrypoint: `index.ts`

Anything not listed here is internal to this module:
